visualCharacteristics: Default: full-bleed background image with the heading over it. Split option: image on the right (about 50%) beside the text column (h1, intro paragraph, bullet list), on the section background; stacks with the image first on narrow screens.
contentPattern: One block, rows: image (picture) and text (h1, paragraph, optional list, optional CTA link). The image may share a cell with the text; the block finds the first picture wherever it is authored.
usage: Page-top hero. Use the split option when the image sits beside the text instead of behind it, as on /financial-professional/annuity-products/product-match-pro (light-grey section).
reuseGuidance: Reuse hero split for any page-top text|image hero. Pair with section metadata style light-grey for the grey band.
